| Corki deals magic damage even if he will choose to build AD (his attacks deal half physical half magic damage), has a nice harass with his Q and R. | This matchup is actually hard to stand against. Under absolutely NO circumstances, NEVER (!) allow this guy to get 5 stacks of his passive on you if you still want to win this matchup.

| Draven relies on auto attacks. If he isn't fed, just engage on him and make your combo : he has no dashes so he is easy ! just take care of his E ( he can bump you and cancel your Q, it's an spell hard to dodge ). Without a lot of life steal, he'll die of it pretty fast.
| Rush Thornmail as usual and apply your trading combo. You will be surprised how fast she'll kill herself.
| Ezreal have a dash so he is quiet hard to catch ! but he'll die kind of fast if you catch him.

| Fiora has kinda weak early game: it's when you have an advantage. Her Riposte (W) is baitable with your Q. To bait her Riposte, you can also just wait for her to use it before you engage with your taunt. Fight her only with active W and taunt her only when you are sure it's good for you: some Fiora players will just dash to you with a riposte, thinking that you will taunt her. Early game and mid game are yours, but late game is hers because of her ultimate who deal a lot of true damages.

| Gangplank has an annoying orange to remove any crowd control: it means that he can cancel your taunts. His barrels deal a lot of damage - either don't stay on them or deny them with your attacks if you are fast enough to do it.

| Garen is really strong against Rammus his ultimate deal true damage and he doesn't need to auto you when he's using E ( spin ), he can cancel your taunt with his W ( shielding himself and granting tenacity ) | The way to make damage against garen is to Taunt him when he can't activate his E (spin) since it makes him unable to attack you (so you won't win trades if he is spinning).

| Kayle often itemizes attack speed. If you will survive till Thornmail, the advantage is yours early/mid game. Care about her ultimate and resistance-shredding passive. Use your combo when her R will be over.
